text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 latency spike observed for /generate in us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T10:12:25Z. SLO breach: p95 220ms (SLO 150ms), p99 1.8s (SLO 500ms). Suspected routing misassignment. See Wavefront: https://wavefront.example.com/chart/abc and PD: https://pagerduty.example.com/incidents/PD1234
Leah: seeing the same, dashboards show streaming stalls for long-tail requests, spike correlates with routing-policy rollout 2026-03-15T10:08 UTC
Sanjay: @Leah which rollout? can we pause
Leah: canaries for 'prefer-local' weight change. I think the new policy bumped affinity weights -> hot partitions
Mike: grabbing router logs, gRPC proxy reports reproxy errors and 502s on some shards
Tara: KV-cache miss rate jumped, looks like lots of prefix misses -> increases backend load
Leah: Customer impact: some streaming sessions drop and many requests hit p99, customers in EU not impacted, mostly US-W and US-E
Aisha: CS alerting customers on affected regions. Any ETA on mitigation?
Leah: immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollout 2) reweight back to previous policy 3) divert heavy streaming routes to fallback model
Mike: I'm running reweight now, command:
```bash
redwoodctl routing reweight --policy prefer-local --region us-west-2 --set 0.4
```
Mike: reweight done, waiting 30s
ops-bot: Automated rollback trigger evaluated: score 0.78 (>=0.7) -> recommending rollback
Leah: rolling back policy to previous commit id abc123
Sanjay: I'm bumping fallback capacity to absorb streaming load: increasing dedicated pool by 2 nodes
Tara: enabling streaming bypass to avoid tail-handshake retries; patching proxy timeout from 5s -> 12s
Leah: logs show tail latency dropping at 10:15:10
Leah: p99 now 560ms, p95 180ms. Still above SLO for p99 but trending down
Aisha: CS update: initial communications sent, SL team preparing postmortem if persists
Mike: root cause hypothesis: policy rollout accidentally produced sticky affinity weights causing hot partitions on specific router shards; combined with KV cache pressure and gRPC proxies timed-out -> tail
Leah: creating livepager and escalating to oncall bridge. Paging @mike and @tara for post-mitigation scrub
oncall-bot: Oncall bridge created: https://meet.example.com/bridge/BR123 at 10:17
Sanjay: we should run compare of routing table hashes across zones, sending quick script
```python
# quick diag
for zone in zones: print(zone, hash(table[zone]))
```
Sanjay: found drift: us-west-2-b had different seed -> mismatch
Leah: patching seed to align and forcing resync
Mike: resync triggered, reindexing shards, cache warming
Leah: tail latency back within SLO at 10:22 (p99 420ms). Bringing down emergency nodes after warmdown
Tara: adding guard in rollout job to validate hash consistency and to block "prefer-local" weight >0.5
Leah: actions assigned:
- Leah: incident lead, coordinate postmortem
- Mike: collect router logs + resync timeline
- Tara: add rollout guard + infra tests
- Sanjay: verify seed fix + add alert for hash-drift
- Aisha: customer comms
Leah: tagging for severity P1 and starting incident timeline doc
Leah: any unresolved? otherwise I'll close the thread once postmortem link exists
Aisha: Confirmed CS has a draft. I'll ping when published :thumbsup:
Leah: closing immediate mitigation, leaving incident open for postmortem tracking
oncall-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (P1 -> investigating) at 6165014320
